y-m-08-10.title: Zingaki imizuzu kuze kuphele ikhandlela?
y-m-08-10.goal: Funda ukuthi kuncipha kangakanani isikhathi ngasinye, njengemizuzu emi-5, uhlukanise inani lezikhathi nesikhathi uma uthola isikhathi esiphelele, bese uqonda ukuthi umcabango wokushisa ngokuqhubekayo uthinta umphumela.

y-m-08-10.thinking.2: Ukubuyela emuva ocabangweni uma isilinganiso sihluka esibikezelweni
y-m-08-10.thinking.3: Ukusho imibandela lapho isiphetho sisebenza khona
y-m-08-10.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa esixazululweni sikaJiho onzima ukuwethemba.

y-m-08-10.s.s1.hint.1: Emugqeni 1 thola ukuthi kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuthi u-2cm unciphe, bese uqhathanisa.
y-m-08-10.s.s1.line.2: Ngakho kuthatha imizuzu eyi-10 ukuthi lishe ngokuphelele.
y-m-08-10.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 3 awulungile. Kuthatha imizuzu emi-5 ukuthi u-2cm unciphe futhi lokho kwenzeka izikhathi eziyi-10, ngakho isikhathi esithathwayo yimizuzu emi-5, izikhathi eziyi-10. Lokhu kuthathe izikhathi eziyi-10 nemizuzu eyi-10 njengento efanayo. Imigqa 1 no-2 ilungile.

y-m-08-10.s.s2.fail.c1: Sicela wenze u-t abe ngumphindaphindo ongu-5 phakathi kuka-0 no-50.

y-m-08-10.s.s3.r.a: Lo mcabango unqume kuqala ukuthi inani liphosile ngemuva kokubona inani elingahambisani nomthetho.
